name: Shugo Seijo Prism Saber
original_name: 守護聖女プリズムセイバー
source:
In the otherworldly realm of Eima Tias, the battle between the Demon King and the Saintess ended with the Demon King being sealed away. His minions plotted to resurrect him, but their scheme backfired, shattering the Innocent Pieces of the seal. The fragments of the Innocent Pieces, along with the Demon King’s followers, crossed through time and space into the modern era. Now in the present day, the Demon King’s minions have begun harvesting energy from humans using monsters to achieve his revival.

In a world without the Saintess, there should have been no one to oppose the Demon King’s forces... yet Celestia, the Saintess from the other world, shared her power with modern-day maidens.

Clutching the Innocent Pieces infused with the Saintess’s power, the girls became shrouded in light. When the light faded, they stood clad in otherworldly garments, ready to protect humanity. What awaits them at the end of their battle against the monsters — victory, or the onslaught of tentacles?

[Translated from the [url=http://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/prism_syo/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
异世界艾玛·提亚斯，魔王与圣女之间的大战以魔王遭到封印而告终。他的部下密谋让魔王复活，计划却适得其反，令维持封印的“纯真碎片”四散破裂。碎片与魔王眷属一同穿越时空，来到现代。如今，魔王部下开始驱使怪物从人类身上收集能量，企图实现他的复活。

在没有圣女的世界，本应无人能够抵抗魔王军……然而，异世界圣女塞蕾丝蒂亚把自己的力量分给了现代少女。

女孩们紧握灌注圣女力量的纯真碎片，身体被光芒笼罩。光辉散去后，她们已身披异世界服装，准备挺身保护人类。与怪物战斗的终点等待着她们的，究竟是胜利，还是触手的侵袭？

[译自[url=http://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/prism_syo/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
